part_label: Asphalt shingle roof cover (laminated, 10-year-old, not impact-rated), whole roof replaced
value_derivation: Hazus one-storey residential roofing cost ratio 3% x repair-and-remodel factor 1.25
threshold_basis: Onset = Haag field threshold for laminated shingles (1.25 in); full = size at which every lab impact damaged 11-year-old laminated shingles (2.0 in)

part_label: Vinyl siding on wood sheathing, cracked or holed panels replaced on the hail-facing elevations
value_derivation: 1,602 ft2 of siding (1,620 ft2 rectangular wall - 243 ft2 windows + 225 ft2 gable ends) x $7/ft2 / $405,000
threshold_basis: Judgment: same band as the laminated shingles; no lab or field threshold for vinyl siding was found

part_label: Residential windows (15% of rectangular wall), broken glazing units replaced
value_derivation: 243 ft2 of windows x $55/ft2 of window / $405,000
threshold_basis: Judgment: glass breakage on vertical glazing starts near 1.5 in and is general by 2.5 in; no lab or field threshold for building windows was found

part_label: Standing-seam steel roof panels (10-year-old), replaced when ruptured or seams opened; cosmetic denting excluded
value_derivation: Judgment: 100,347 ft2 of roof x about $13.15/ft2 = $1.32M / $11.0M (range 9-15%)
threshold_basis: Onset = Haag threshold for rupturing steel panels in good to fair condition (2.5 in); full = judgment (3.5 in)
